newsitem.title: ESTONIA: STATE'S ROLE IN ECONOMY WILL CONTINUE TO BE CUT.
newsitem.headline: STATE'S ROLE IN ECONOMY WILL CONTINUE TO BE CUT.

text.p: Estonia will maintain a fiscal policy based on strict budget guidelines, with a goal to decrease the government's stake in the economy, Mart Opmann, the finance minister, said on Monday.
Opmann said in a speech to German economic journalists that Estonia will decrease the government's stake in the economy via privatisation.
"We will complete the privatisation of industrial, trade, transport and service companies," he said, adding that in the next two years infrastructure and energy companies will also be sold.
Estonia will continue a conserative foreign loan policy to keep the money supply balanced and control inflation, he added.
